description: The line diff of the Hub (lib/line-diff.mjs): lines that keep their terminator, the shortest script (Myers) with its bounds, the hunks with three lines of context, hunks merged six lines apart, the counts and the digest, judged by tests/verify-line-diff.mjs (hand-made shapes, exact text, 2500 seeded pairs against a longest-common-subsequence table, the bounds).

mutations.name: LD-context-two
mutations.what: two lines of context instead of three

mutations.name: LD-context-four
mutations.what: four lines of context instead of three

mutations.name: LD-merge-gap-short
mutations.what: changes six lines apart are two hunks

mutations.name: LD-merge-gap-long
mutations.what: changes seven lines apart are one hunk

mutations.name: LD-edit-length-small
mutations.what: the search gives up after ten edits

mutations.name: LD-edit-length-large
mutations.what: the search never gives up on the edits

mutations.name: LD-steps-small
mutations.what: the search gives up after ten steps

mutations.name: LD-steps-unbounded
mutations.what: the step limit is not checked
mutations.equivalent: no input reaches 4,000,000 steps under the 1000-edit limit (the most of about thirty adversarial inputs, 100,000 lines of repeated text with up to 900 edits, was 957,056): the cap is a second guard, and its constant is pinned by LD-steps-small

mutations.name: LD-split-no-terminator
mutations.what: a line loses its line feed

mutations.name: LD-split-last-line
mutations.what: a last line without a terminator is dropped

mutations.name: LD-split-cr
mutations.what: a carriage return ends a line

mutations.name: LD-head-off
mutations.what: the common first lines are not set aside
mutations.equivalent: only makes the search run over more lines: the shortest script is the same

patches.old: while (head < a.length && head < b.length && a[head] === b[head]) head += 1;

mutations.name: LD-tail-off
mutations.what: the common last lines are not set aside

patches.old: while (tail < a.length - head && tail < b.length - head && a[a.length - 1 - tail] === b[b.length - 1 - tail]) tail += 1;

mutations.name: LD-tail-overlap
mutations.what: the last lines may reach into the first lines

patches.old: while (tail < a.length - head && tail < b.length - head &&

mutations.name: LD-equal-texts
mutations.what: equal texts are not recognised

mutations.name: LD-equal-either
mutations.what: a text that is a prefix of the other has no change

mutations.name: LD-pure-change
mutations.what: a pure insertion or removal is searched like any change
mutations.equivalent: the search answers a pure insertion or removal with the same single block

mutations.name: LD-search-tie
mutations.what: a tie between going down and going right goes the other way

patches.old: v[offset + k - 1] < v[offset + k + 1]) ? v[offset + k + 1]
patches.new: v[offset + k - 1] <= v[offset + k + 1]) ? v[offset + k + 1]

mutations.name: LD-search-wrong-way
mutations.what: the furthest path is the lower one

patches.old: v[offset + k - 1] < v[offset + k + 1]) ? v[offset + k + 1]
patches.new: v[offset + k - 1] > v[offset + k + 1]) ? v[offset + k + 1]

mutations.name: LD-search-edge
mutations.what: the diagonal at the edge is chosen like the others

patches.old: let x = k === -d || (k !== d && v[offset + k - 1] < v[offset + k + 1]) ?
patches.new: let x = (k !== d && v[offset + k - 1] < v[offset + k + 1]) ?

mutations.name: LD-search-step
mutations.what: going right does not take a line

mutations.name: LD-search-end
mutations.what: the search stops when it reaches the end of one list

patches.old: if (x >= n && y >= m) return blocksFrom(trace, n, m);
patches.new: if (x >= n || y >= m) return blocksFrom(trace, n, m);

mutations.name: LD-search-snake
mutations.what: a run of equal lines is not followed

patches.old: while (x < n && y < m && a[x] === b[y]) {

mutations.name: LD-trace-offset
mutations.what: the walk back reads the paths one place off

mutations.name: LD-back-sign
mutations.what: a line taken away and a line put in are swapped

mutations.name: LD-back-first-round
mutations.what: the walk back counts a move that was never made

mutations.name: LD-back-choice
mutations.what: the walk back chooses the other path

mutations.name: LD-blocks-open
mutations.what: a change next to a change is not one block

mutations.name: LD-group-strict
mutations.what: changes exactly six lines apart are two hunks

mutations.name: LD-group-never
mutations.what: changes are never merged

mutations.name: LD-visible-bom
mutations.what: a byte order mark counts as a character of the line

mutations.name: LD-visible-crlf
mutations.what: a carriage return counts as a character of the line

mutations.name: LD-looks-length
mutations.what: a line that appears looks like no change

mutations.name: LD-looks-every
mutations.what: one line that looks the same is enough

mutations.name: LD-before-context
mutations.what: the context before the first line reaches outside the file

mutations.name: LD-removed-count
mutations.what: the removed lines are counted on the new side

patches.old: removed: blocks.reduce((total, block) => total + block.aEnd - block.aStart, 0),
patches.new: removed: blocks.reduce((total, block) => total + block.bEnd - block.bStart, 0),

mutations.name: LD-added-count
mutations.what: the added lines are counted on the old side

patches.old: added: blocks.reduce((total, block) => total + block.bEnd - block.bStart, 0),
patches.new: added: blocks.reduce((total, block) => total + block.aEnd - block.aStart, 0),

mutations.name: LD-row-kind
mutations.what: a removed line is drawn as an added one

mutations.name: LD-interior-context
mutations.what: the lines between two changes are taken from the old side

mutations.name: LD-after-context
mutations.what: four lines of context after the last change

mutations.name: LD-block-offset
mutations.what: the places of the blocks forget the lines set aside at the start

mutations.name: LD-fallback
mutations.what: a change that is too scattered has no hunk at all

mutations.name: LD-additions
mutations.what: additions are the removed lines

mutations.name: LD-deletions
mutations.what: deletions are the added lines

mutations.name: LD-digest-length
mutations.what: the length of a row is not part of the digest

mutations.name: LD-digest-kind
mutations.what: the kind of a row is not part of the digest

mutations.name: LD-digest-separator
mutations.what: hunks are not separated in the digest

mutations.name: LD-digest-place
mutations.what: the place of a hunk is not part of the digest
